metadata.selection:
Build mini_demo_data.json: a curated 99-state subset of the nla_readout_states dataset of experiment 32.

Every example is an unchanged row of full_method_out.json -> nla_readout_states, plus one joined field,
metadata_state_index (the state's row of cache/states_index.jsonl, the S4 state index; it carries the `mixed`
flag, sample_id and pos_class that analysis/readout.py reads). The subset holds one block of states per committed
readout test, so the notebook can run the S9 analysis code on it:

  N3      forced "Implement Y" prompts: every forced read-out mode of the 7 re-gated tasks, READ, W1     15
  N1      T05 ban states, W1/W2/W3/W5 x SPEC-3..READ (the complete committed N1 unit set)           16
  N1-swap T05 twin states at the same templates and positions (also N2 on T05)                        16
  N2      twin READ W1 state of the six other defaulted tasks                                         6
  N8b     ban READ W1 state of the six ban-failure tasks                                              6
  N6      generated-token states g1..g16 of 8 samples drawn (seed 20261022) from the 6 mixed groups   40
